pass19__wanderer_survive.name: WANDERER
pass19__wanderer_survive.anatomicalSides: Original standard2018 human-derived Wanderer, NOT armoured and NOT Bomber. Grey exposed bare human torso with black crystalline deposits at shoulders/forearms. Head entirely replaced/covered by irregular black crystal cluster with ONE long angled red translucent pointed crystal. No visible regular human face, eyes or hair. Black charcoal straight trousers, black belt and plain dark shoes. Exactly two bare humanoid arms and two legs. Match slender ordinary human body proportions from licensed sculpture; no stylised demon armour.
pass19__wanderer_survive.sourceScope: Canonical shirtless appearance and trousers supported by official gameplay + licensed Gecco sculpture; pose motion/rear occlusion is authored adaptation.

pass19__mortar_survive.anatomicalSides: Original2018 Mortar creature. Very bulky charcoal-black glossy irregular crystalline covering on head, chest, shoulders and ONE huge organic cannon arm. Red pointed head crystal. One ordinary small grey humanoid opposite hand/arm; dark loose trousers and ordinary heavy dark feet. No human face, no carried gun or military artillery machine. Preserve anatomical RIGHT massive crystal cannon arm visible on VIEWER LEFT in original front-facing screenshot; other ordinary arm is anatomical LEFT. Do not mirror arm assignment between facing atlases. The original screenshot is dark; tiny crystalline topology/unlit clothing is not independently certified.
pass19__mortar_survive.sourceScope: Original screenshot is visual authority for enlarged cannon arm; community text differs on arm naming, so right-arm assignment is an observed front-body reading requiring review, not certified exact model topology.

pass19__big_mouth_survive.name: BIG MOUTH
pass19__big_mouth_survive.anatomicalSides: BIG MOUTH is the original Metal Gear Survive boss in the supplied genuine released-game captures. Huge low hunched nonhuman mutant with enormous front mouth/head, thick gloss-black violet crystalline armour, thin sharp yellow stripes running over tall domed shoulder/back plates, patches of pale purplish exposed flesh at throat and belly. Large tooth-lined mouth with hook-shaped irregular black crystal mandibles and tusklike teeth, two thick hind legs with broad clawed feet, exactly two powerful front forelimbs with large hooked crystalline claws and a tapering spiked long tail trailing behind. Match its photographed squatting gorilla-like reptilian four-limbed stance. It is NOT a humanoid Wanderer, NOT a dinosaur T-rex with tiny arms, NOT a robot. No human head/face, shirt, trousers, shoes, red head spike, rifle, straps, tie or ordinary eyes. Back and hidden reverse detail are conservative interpretations from visible source evidence, never claim unseen exact topology.
pass19__big_mouth_survive.sourceScope: Close released-game screenshots attest major visible front/side anatomy and yellow-black plating. Hidden rear surfaces and every CQC pose are authored adaptation; machine-gun growth phase is omitted pending a close physical reference. Presentation height is estimated, not a canonical metre measurement.

pass19__frostbite_survive.name: FROSTBITE
pass19__frostbite_survive.anatomicalSides: FROSTBITE is the original Metal Gear Survive boss shown in the actual close game screenshot. An enormous nonhuman cephalopod-like creature: central tilted pointed dark-violet graphite carapace, like a tall rounded asymmetric teardrop/pyramidal dome with three visible large circular shuttered recessed iris plates on its front, fine concentric organic metal ridges and curved overlapping armour. Exactly EIGHT very long thin flexible ribbed grey-white tentacles rooted around the base of this one carapace; long narrow ribbons with sharp black edge ridges, three small pointed red translucent crystal tips and five turquoise icy-blue tips. Tips remain attached to their own tentacles. No human/animal face or ordinary eyes, no teeth or jaws, no extra head stalk, no clothes or machinery rifle. Retain dark purple dome and pale ribbed ribbons from supplied photograph; unseen backside and tentacle occlusions are interpreted conservatively, not claimed exact.
pass19__frostbite_survive.sourceScope: One close original released-game capture supports visible violet central dome, shuttered iris recesses, eight pale ribbed ribbons and red/cyan tips. Hidden surfaces and CQC motions are authored adaptations. Exact visible tip counts can be occluded by folded tentacles; not a full 3D topology certificate.
